title: World Bank Country Growth Indicators
description: Latest GDP growth, CPI inflation, and exports growth per country from the World Bank Indicators API (most recent 3 years, latest non-null observation kept per country). Each row is tagged INVESTABLE_EM (Brazil/India/China/Mexico/South Africa/Turkey/Indonesia/Philippines/Poland/Thailand/Vietnam/Taiwan/Korea/Japan/Argentina/Chile/Colombia/Peru/Malaysia/Egypt/Nigeria/Saudi Arabia/UAE/Qatar/Hungary/Pakistan/Bangladesh + others), DEVELOPED, or FRONTIER. ETF hint column maps ISO3 country code to the most-liquid US-listed ETF (EWZ/INDA/FXI/EWW/EZA/TUR/EIDO/EPHE/EPOL/THD/VNM/EWT/EWY/EWJ/...). Growth tier (EXPLOSIVE/STRONG/STEADY/SLUGGISH/CONTRACTING) gives Claude an instant rotation signal for the Global Macro Risk Brief. Free World Bank Indicators API, no auth.
